headline: Poland’s WIG20 Index Bounces 1.5% to End Four-Day Losing Streak
summary: The Warsaw Stock Exchange turned higher on Monday after four consecutive declining sessions, led by a gain of over 1.5% in the benchmark WIG20 index.
why: The WIG20 index tracks the twenty largest companies listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange in Central Europe.

impacts.name: WIG20
impacts.why: Poland's benchmark WIG20 index gained more than 1.5% to snap a four-day losing streak.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Polish equities rebounded as risk appetite returned across European stock exchanges.
